boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Braddock Road and Main Street, each paired with one verified reason to leave George Mason University’s Fairfax campus orbit.

cards.title: Breakfast Tacos Across from Campus
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Head along Braddock Road for all-day breakfast, then choose from tacos, empanadas, quesadillas, tortas, and vegetarian options.
cards.short_summary: A Braddock Road stop with an unusually broad all-day breakfast menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official location page places its Fairfax branch at 10629 Braddock Road across from George Mason University and documents all-day breakfast and patio seating.
cards.source_title: Fairfax at University Mall, VA | Hours + Location | Taco Bamba
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily opening at 8 a.m.; food purchases are required.

cards.title: Platters After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Use the Braddock Road block for a late meal built around chicken or beef-gyro platters, sandwiches, rice, pita, and signature sauces.
cards.short_summary: A clearly documented late-hours food option on the campus-facing corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Fairfax location page lists 10625 Braddock Road, displays chicken and beef-gyro platters and sandwiches, and posts midnight or later closing times.
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; verify holiday changes before leaving.

cards.title: Smoothies on the Braddock Block
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Walk the Braddock Road corridor when a smoothie, wrap, or flatbread fits the plan; confirm the 10655 address before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward smoothie-and-light-meal stop beside the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Tropical Smoothie Cafe’s official Fairfax locator identifies a branch at 10655 Braddock Road and describes the chain’s smoothies, wraps, and flatbreads.
cards.source_title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe Locations in Fairfax
cards.access_notes: The official locator currently shows a 9 p.m. closing; purchases are required and hours may change.

cards.title: Sandwiches, Salads, and Spuds
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Choose this Braddock Road stop when the group wants sandwiches, salads, or baked potatoes, with pickup and curbside service documented.
cards.short_summary: A flexible deli stop with several official pickup options.
cards.evidence_claim: McAlister’s official location page places the University Mall deli at 10691 Braddock Road and documents sandwiches, salads, spuds, inside pickup, and curbside pickup.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists service until 9 p.m. daily; purchases are required.

cards.title: A 2 A.M. Drive-Thru Option
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — west of Ox Road
cards.notes: Keep this Braddock Road destination for genuinely late food; check the official locator before relying on its posted 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: The corridor’s directly verified option for food well after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official locator identifies the restaurant at 10695A Braddock Road and lists restaurant and drive-through hours ending at 2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-through hours are 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Mason Gear Behind Taco Bamba
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Go to the center of University Mall for Mason apparel and gifts; the shop says its entrance sits behind Taco Bamba on this block.
cards.short_summary: A locally situated stop for university apparel and gifts.
cards.evidence_claim: SuitUp’s official page places its retail store at 10627 Braddock Road in University Mall and says it is located behind Taco Bamba.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m. weekdays and noon–4 p.m. weekends, with listed holiday closures.

cards.title: Comics, Manga, and Trading Cards
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Browse the Braddock Road shop for new comics, back issues, manga, Pokémon and MTG cards, statues, or an in-store subscription form.
cards.short_summary: A named specialty shop for comics, manga, collectibles, and card games.
cards.evidence_claim: The shop’s official About page gives the address as 10647 Braddock Road and documents comics, manga, Pokémon and MTG cards, statues, and subscriptions.
cards.source_title: About Us | The Amazing Comic Shop
cards.access_notes: The official page posts daily hours, including a noon opening Sunday; merchandise purchases are required.

cards.title: First-Run Movies Beside Campus
cards.subtitle: Braddock Road corridor — University Mall
cards.notes: Check the theater’s official schedule, pick an age-appropriate screening, and follow Braddock Road to the 10659-A entrance.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed cinema directly on the campus-facing commercial block.
cards.evidence_claim: The theater’s official website identifies University Mall Theatres at 10659-A Braddock Road and publishes current and upcoming movie listings.
cards.access_notes: Admission is ticketed; consult the official schedule and film rating before visiting.

cards.title: The Fairfax Story on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — Old Town Fairfax
cards.notes: Continue along Main Street to examine local-history exhibits, then use the visitor center for orientation to other city sites.
cards.short_summary: A civic history stop anchoring the eastern approach to Old Town Fairfax.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Fairfax places the museum at 10209 Main Street and identifies it as a historic resource with public visiting hours and tours.
cards.source_title: Fairfax Museum | City of Fairfax, VA
cards.access_notes: The city lists hours of 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Wednesday–Monday, Tuesday closure, and additional holiday closures.

cards.title: Independent and International Film
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — Fair City Mall
cards.notes: Follow Main Street east to select an age-appropriate independent, international, or limited-release film from the official showtime board.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street cinema focused on films beyond standard wide releases.
cards.evidence_claim: Cinema Arts Theatre’s official site gives its address as 9650 Unit 14 Main Street and publishes current and forthcoming film listings.
cards.access_notes: Admission is ticketed; consult official showtimes and film ratings before visiting.
